title: Mark Wahlberg's charity marks 25 years, distributing nearly $20m to help disadvantaged children
summary_full: In 2001, Mark Wahlberg and Jim Wahlberg established the Mark Wahlberg Youth Foundation with a mission to uplift disadvantaged youth. Since its inception, the foundation has raised nearly $20 million, funding essential initiatives like summer camps, educational resources, and community recreation spaces. By partnering with various organizations, they strive to enhance the quality of life for children, focusing on health awareness and providing crucial support for families in need.
